extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities. Sourced from Stack Exchange, it contains 64,696 visual questions with authentic context, answers validated by askers, and lengthy answers (mean 173 words).
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari
extraction.publisher: University of Texas at Austin, Microsoft, University of Colorado Boulder
extraction.citeAs: Chen, C., Liu, M., Codella, N., Li, Y., Yuan, L., & Gurari, D. (2024). Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities. arXiv:2311.15562v4.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was scraped from the Stack Exchange online question-answering platform using publicly-available data spanning August 2010 to November 2022. Only examples with a natural language question, context, image, and at least one answer marked as 'accepted answer' by the asker were collected.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Stack Exchange archive (https://archive.org/details/stackexchange) in XML format.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering steps: removed visual questions with scores <= 0 for question or answer, removed those with multiple images or visual answers, removed examples where image could not be downloaded. Converted all images to png format.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: User intentions were annotated by crowdworkers from Amazon Mechanical Turk. Each of 105 VQAs (one per topic) was labeled by two independent workers; disagreements were resolved by a third worker. Annotators were provided with taxonomy definitions and examples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Agreement accuracy improved from 53.3% to 87.5% and Cohen's kappa from 45.24% to 84.69% over four rounds of refinement. Final labels used majority vote.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Crowdworkers located in the United States with >500 HITs and >95% approval rating.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet. Geographic representation is unbalanced, with more from US, India, Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may have biases due to the Stack Exchange user base, which is skewed towards certain demographics and topics. Models trained on this data may inherit these biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas and has unbalanced geographic representation. Answers are lengthy, making standard VQA evaluation metrics ineffective.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Suitable for improving VQA models for authentic use cases, especially those requiring long-form answers and context understanding.
